verdict.rationale: Stripe's dedicated Financial Connections webhooks page documents events for newly linked accounts, completed balance refreshes, completed transaction refreshes and completed ownership refreshes, plus guidance on relinking inactive accounts. That covers the new-transactions, balance-update and connection-state parts of the story. Missing for 10: no evidence in the pack that these webhooks are cryptographically signed, the connection-state (inactive/disconnected) event is only implied by the relink guidance, events signal refresh completion rather than per-transaction pushes, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
